newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's ColMut plans capital issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's ColMut plans capital issue.

text.p: Australian mutual financial services group Colonial Ltd said on Friday its A$215 million purchase of Jardine Matheson Holdings Ltd's 50 percent stake in their Asian insurance joint venture, Jardine CMG Life, would be largely financed by a capital issue later this year.

"It is currently proposed to fund this purchase predominantly through a specific capital raising, at the time of listing, details of which will be included in our prospectus to be issued in the second quarter of this year," Colonial Managing Director Peter Smedley said in a joint statement with Jardine.
Earlier, Colonial said its subsidiary CMG Asia had agreed to buy the balance of Jardine CMG for a total of US$163 million (A$215 million).
Jardine CMG has wholly-owned operations in Hong Kong and Singapore and has further ventures with local partners in Indonesia, the Philippines and Thailand.
Jardine Pacific said it would record a net exceptional profit of about US$130 million in respect of the transactions in its 1997 result.
Colonial and Jardine said they had both benefited from the partnership and would be pleased to work together on future projects.

"We are please to have helped build a successful business, but feel that the time is right for Jardine Pacific to unlock the value built up in the investment so as to concentrate more fully on businesses where we can bring more added value," Jardine Pacific Chairman Anthony Nightingale said in the statement.
Colonial Managing Director Peter Smedley said the acquisition would help position Colonial in the lead-up to listing on the Australian Stock Exchange in the second quarter of 1997.
"We wanted to provide investors with a greater stake in the growth markets of Asia," Smedley said in the statement.
